concerns.text: FR-005 and SC-002 require sensitivity analysis with 'at least three alternative multivariate operationalizations' and explicit mathematical formulas. Task T027b defines these formulas in 'sensitivity_formulas.md', but Task T028 (the engine) explicitly depends on 'data/processed/sensitivity_formulas.json'. The plan and tasks do not include a conversion step to generate the required JSON artifact from the markdown definition, leaving the engine task T028 unable to execute its dependency.

FR-006 requires detecting straight-lining across the 'full set of stimuli'. Task T016 implements the detector but relies on T013 (stimulus generation) to define the 'full set'. However, T016's description states it must 'validate count of stimuli against data/raw/stimuli.csv... before flagging'. There is no explicit task to ensure the stimulus count is passed as a configuration or environment variable to T016, or that T016 dynamically reads the count from the generated file at runtime. Without a task explicitly handling this dynamic count resolution, the logic in T016 is incomplete.

SC-005 requires the full pipeline to complete within 6 hours. Task T037 benchmarks this. However, T037 depends on T009 (Power Analysis) to set N. The Analyze report indicates T009b (power curve visualization) is rejected/missing. If T009b is a prerequisite for the 'Verified Accuracy' gate mentioned in T009b's description, and the pipeline cannot run without passing this gate, then T037 cannot validly measure SC-005 until T009b is resolved. No task exists to re-implement or fix T009b.

Task T010 is marked [X] (complete) but its description states it 'validates data/raw/stimuli.csv produced by T013'. T013 is marked [ ] (incomplete). A contract test cannot exist or be marked complete if the artifact it validates has not been generated. This is a stale status flag.

Task T012 is marked [X] (complete) but depends on T016 (straight-lining detector), which is marked [ ] (incomplete). A unit test for a feature that is not implemented cannot be complete. This is a stale status flag.

Task T023 is marked [X] (complete) but depends on T016 (cleaning log), which is marked [ ] (incomplete). The validation check cannot be complete if the upstream data cleaning artifact is missing. This is a stale status flag.
